title: Finite complex construction: root traversal saves 10 more historical roles
body:
Finite historical complex-supplier construction; **no new kappa**. A different root-channel traversal reduces PR863's h22 disjoint-triple DAG from **30,708 to 30,698 additions** and the reversible embedding from **32,248 to 32,238 paid helper roles**. The complete historical invoice saves **80 scalar operations per signed invocation**, or **569,184,000** across all three stages, with every mixer/inverse, source access, weighted injection, restoration, intersection-two helper, centre, join and recursive child charged.

Seed **25** selected the complex-supplier track. All sixteen simultaneous-tie recipes first matched PR863's existing best. One evidence-driven pivot completed **24 root cardinality traversals × four nondegenerate tie choices = 96 recipes**, with fixed points, descendant plans and interning convention. Six attain 30,698; the seed selects order `(1,2,3,0)` and reversed channel `(1,1)`. This changes the search class beyond PR863's at-most-one-flip scan; it is not global circuit optimality.

Only `research/disjoint-joint-ties/` is added. Exact base: **bbc600db2fc15007b7c914f4f2b2ed55fa909c87**. Historical source: **1a74950ce5074b848243ba89d8022fbadba66105**. PR863 head: **6c0ed3975fda8f0190b34f1b1bbedb33a925d339**. Source pins, complete certificate, scoped negative result, invoice, local claim and validation receipt are included. Fresh upstream is 407d52ff15b2217b6e22bce44728b4c3907b6515; the selected certificate and studied supplier sources are unchanged there. Refreshed PR searches found no matching root-traversal contribution.

Reproduce with standard-library Python **3.10+**:

```sh
python3 -B research/disjoint-joint-ties/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_JOINT_ROOT_CONSTRUCTION additions=30708->30698 paid_roles_saved=10 no_new_kappa`.

Validation on macOS arm64 / Python 3.12.14:

- Exact maps and reversible embeddings for both finite domains: **265,619,200 coefficient positions**, including forbidden zeros.
- A separate implementation importing no repository code matches six complete maps and node hashes; both h22 frame orientations and explicit h8/h10 residual bases pass.
- All h8 independent dirty columns in both signs, eight dense dyadic h22 probes, nine focused tests and five original tensor tests pass.
- Normal outside-checkout replay and isolated optimized relocation with spaces pass. Corrupted source bytes are rejected while preserving the certificate. Inherited assertion checks ignore `PYTHONOPTIMIZE`.
- `make selected-record-check` and whitespace checks pass. Hosted CI is separate.

The selected T37 kappa remains **0.001661960547713947**. This older supplier remains far behind it; selected hosting/precision transport and outer composition are not supplied. All-size/compiler, common labels and mutable sources, hosting, precision/tape and analytic transfer remain inherited assumptions. No full repository replay, Lean multiplication proof or measured runtime improvement is claimed.

Prepared for **@ToikY** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including separately implemented AI checks. Credits **Curtis Dransfield** for PR863 and **Douglas R. Colkitt** for the retained tensor, phase, compiler and invocation work, plus the source-notice lineage. Apache-2.0; no independent human peer review claimed. `upstream/` and the selected frontier remain unchanged.
